text:
Raat kitni hi lambi kyun na ho,
Subah ki pehli kiran apna rasta dhoond hi leti hai.
Andheron se lad kar jo subah aati hai,
Uski baat hi kuch aur hoti hai.
Thoda sabr rakho mere dost,
Tumhare sitare bhi abhi chamkenge.
title: Nayi Subah Ki Umeed
description: Ek warm aur uplifting shayeri jo akelapan ke baad naye din ki umeed aur attitude ko darshati hai.
